title: Influence of the binary inner-product function
statement: For every positive integer $m$, define $F:\{-1,1\}^{2m}\to\{-1,1\}$ by splitting the input into sign vectors corresponding to $u,v\in\mathbb{F}_2^m$ and setting $F=(-1)^{u\cdot v}$, where the dot product is computed modulo $2$. Then for every coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,2m\}$, the influence of $F$ at $i$ is $1/2$.
